question: India’s First Wildlife Corridor Built on Delhi-Mumbai Highway Near ___________ Wildlife Sanctuary.
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Ranthambore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India’s First Wildlife Corridor Built on Delhi-Mumbai Highway Near Ranthambore Wildlife Sanctuary.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**NHAI** (National Highways Authority of India) has created **India’s first dedicated wildlife corridor** on a **national highway**.

 
 
• 
 
It is a **12-km stretch** on the **Delhi-Mumbai Expressway**.

 
 
• 
 
The corridor passes through the **buffer zone** of **Ranthambore Tiger Reserve**.

 
 
• 
 
Features include **five wildlife overpasses** and **India’s longest underpass** built **exclusively for animal movement**.

 
 
• 
 
This is the **first expressway in India** designed to **balance human travel and wildlife protection**.

 
 
• 
 
The project was developed with input from the **Wildlife Institute of India** and the **Ministry of Environment and Forests**.

 
 
• 
 
It connects the **Ranthambore and Chambal Valley**, which is rich in biodiversity including **tigers, leopards, bears**, and **other endangered species**.
